data.name: Nirupa
data.gender_notes: Nirupa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nirupa originates from the Sanskrit language and translates to 'lifting the darkness'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the goddess Durga, who is revered for her power to dispel ignorance and bring light into the world. The name Nirupa symbolizes courage, wisdom, and compassion, as well as the ability to overcome adversity and bring about positive change.
data.etymology: Nirupa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lifting the darkness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nirupa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
